title: SRP-Info
description: A Mod designed for Scape & Run: Parasites to show information about what part your currently at more easily
body:
**SRP-Info is a mod that adds information about the current SRP stages**

*for multiplayer support, the mod must be on the server.


it has

* Phase level
* Percentage till next phase
* Ubiquitous Development [Starts showing @ level 1]
* Amount of Nodes [Starts showing @ level 4 Ubiquitous]

***Preview in gallery***
